liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (1 review): Vince's repetitive solos and loud backup vocals are criticized for disrupting the jam's flow [10]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Jerry allegedly forgot the lyrics, playing the instrumental bridge indefinitely before regrouping to finish [4]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): A 30-minute version dominated the second set, marking a special moment for the 14-year-old listener [12]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Described as a favorite memory, featuring three drummers and Jerry's rich, fat tone [5]

## The recordings

- **gd94-12-09.sbd.miller.12052.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 176 min; rated 3.87/5 by 14 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer claims the disc mix sounds better than the poor live mix inside the Coliseum [4]
- **gd1994-12-09.aud.vinson.81379.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1994-12-09.141234.mk4.ebel.flac1648**: source not stated; 18 songs; 184 min [3]

## Around the show

- A gentleman smuggled a La Croix bottle containing something else, passing it to the entire section [7]
- Listeners discovered a secret room near the Rock Med area with two speakers for dancing [8]
- This was the listener's first time seeing the band perform Scarlet Begonias into Fire On The Mountain [11]
- The listener attended to celebrate their son's first birthday, dancing in the halls and chasing him [15]
- Reviewer argues the 1994 sound is incohesive and sporadic, far past the band's peak performance [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-12-09.sbd.miller.12052.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD -> Dat -> CD [1]. Also: John Cutler adjusted the mix, turning Jerry down while bringing Bob and Vince up; Soundboard recording transferred to DAT then CD, seeded by Charlie Miller [1][14]
- **gd1994-12-09.aud.vinson.81379.flac16**: transferred by Dan Vinson; source: AUD > ? > CDR > Plextor PX-716UF > EAC v0.9b2 > FLAC Frontend v1.7.1 level 8 [2]. Also: Audience recording received in trade years ago; no editing was done on the extracted wav files [2]
- **gd1994-12-09.141234.mk4.ebel.flac1648**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: flac16/48 Source Info: Schoeps MK4->Reutelhuber P/S-> DATTransfer Info: DAT (Panasonic SV-3700) -> Coaxial SPDIF-> Marantz PMD 661 MKII (Solid State… [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-12-11 Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum, Oakland, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-12-11-oakland-alameda-county-coliseum-oakland-ca-usa/) [17]
